text:
ria: flagged by infra-ci: vendor repo contains what looks like KMS-wrapped vault transit ciphertext in a test fixture. No plaintext.
marta: link pls
ria: https://github.com/vendor/acme-demo/commit/def5678 — string starts with vault:v1: and references projects/redwood-infra/locations/us/keyRings/onboard/cryptoKeys/relay-wrap
sam: immediate: snapshot KMS IAM, check audit logs for Decrypt, ask vendor to remove and force-push.
vendor-eng: thanks, we pushed the repo copy to vendor-security so you could triage. We'll remove the commit and rebase asap.
sec-bot: INCIDENT-2026-060 created: sec-546001 (severity: medium).
oncall: tagging vault oncall for potential rewrap concerns @oncall
oncall: happy to support rewrap, prefer rolling rewrap to avoid downtime.
marta: ran quick IAM diff: relay-wrap key had a binding for group:external-devs@vendor. Removing that now would be good, but check for active decrypts first.
sam: audit query: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type=kms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName:Decrypt' --limit 500` — found zero Decrypts by vendor principals in last 180d. Good sign.
ria: vendor will remove commit in 10m and provide signed attestation.
vendor-eng: removed and force-pushed; attestation attached to ticket. We'll also rotate local test artifacts.
marta: still propose three actions:
1) remove vendor group from key IAM (with a rollback snapshot)
2) add conditional IAM binding to only allow our relay SA
3) create log-based alert for KMS Decrypt events from non-relay principals
sam: I'll snapshot IAM policy now: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy relay-wrap --keyring=onboard --location=us > relay-wrap-iam.json` and export logs.
oncall: schedule rewrap window tonight 20:00-20:30 PT. I'll standby for Vault rewrap failures.
vendor-eng: confirmed test fixtures cleaned from all mirrors.
marta: applied IAM delta in staging, removed vendor group. Opening PR to prod IAM change for review.
ria: CI update: adding git-secrets rule to block vault:v
sam: added log metric `kms_decrypt_unexpected` -> PagerDuty if count>0 in 15m.
sec-bot: INCIDENT-2026-060 status changed to resolved (post rotation and IAM change).
marta: postmortem actions: update onboarding docs, tighten key RBAC, org-scan for vault:v ciphertext, add CI block.
ria: thanks all — I'll write up the postmortem and assign owners. :thumbsup:
